findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?via=registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: commodity_edge · Private data: commodity_edge, nfl_edge, nfl_prop_edge, fifteen_min_board, track_record · Public sink: start_sit, explain_prop · Destructive: convert_probability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: commodity_edge · Private data: commodity_edge, nfl_edge, nfl_prop_edge, fifteen_min_board, track_record · Public sink: start_sit, explain_prop · Destructive: convert_probability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
